Title: Replay one millisecond before retry expiry
Steps: 1. In isolated QA control server time and create a valid first order for customer A and reference K at T0; retain the request and original order snapshot. 2. Refill A's bag with available goods; record bag and stock. 3. At T0+24h-1ms authenticate A with a fresh session and resubmit K.
Expected Result: Returns the original order ID, createdAt, product snapshot and amounts; no new order or stock change occurs; refilled bag is untouched.
Selection Reason: Prove inclusive protection before the exact expiry and avoid false failure from the eight-hour session limit.
Catalog Gap: Catalog has no REQ-018 cases and no retry-time boundary.

Title: New order exactly at retry expiry
Steps: 1. In isolated QA create a first order for A with K at T0. 2. Refill A's bag with one available $80.00 product. 3. At exactly T0+24h use a fresh A session and submit K with valid delivery and no discount.
Expected Result: A different order ID is created with current createdAt; original order is unchanged; order count increases by one; stock decreases by one; bag clears; new shipping is $5.00 and total $85.00.

Title: New order one millisecond after retry expiry

Expected Result: A new order is created; original order remains unchanged; new quantities reduce stock once and clear the current bag.

Title: Expired retry with empty bag

Title: First-order timestamp anchors expiry permanently

Title: Reference protection is customer scoped

Title: Different reference starts separate checkout within window

Expected Result: A new order for L is created; K's order is unchanged; stock and bag change only for the new purchase.

Title: Restart preserves original retry window
Steps: 1. Create A/K order at T0 in isolated QA; retain persisted store. 2. Restart at T0+23h; sign in again and refill bag. 3. Submit K and inspect state. 4. Advance to T0+24h and submit K again with a fresh valid session.

Title: Expired session does not determine retry lifetime
